environment.description: Terraform provider backend deployed on an EC2 instance in a public subnet with a Network Load Balancer (NLB) forwarding TCP/8443 traffic directly. Security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8443. No WAF or additional filtering is configured. The service is reachable from any IP on the internet.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP passthrough, no IP filtering
config.database: PostgreSQL RDS in same VPC, no query-level audit logging
